about: Mirror Dungeon E.G.O Gifts (tier, sin, keyword, shop cost, enhance levels, effect at base level). Data from the Limbus Company Wiki (limbuscompany.wiki.gg, Module:EgoGift/data, CC BY-SA 4.0), read 2026-11-11.

gifts.name: Hellterfly’s Dream
gifts.effect:
When applying Burn Potency or 'Unique Burn' to an enemy with Burn or 'Unique Burn', randomly inflict a total of 3 Burn Potency between all enemies.
When activating Wrath Absolute Resonance, randomly inflict a total of 5 Burn Potency between all enemies at Combat Start.

gifts.name: Perversion
gifts.effect:
After defeating 1 or more enemy using an Attack Skill, gain +1 E.G.O resource of that Attack Skill's Affinity at the next Turn Start.
If the Attack Skill's Affinity was Wrath, gain +1 E.G.O resource of all affinities the ally has at the next Turn Start instead.

gifts.name: Ashes to Ashes
gifts.effect: Combat Start: if all enemies (or all Abnormality parts) have Burn or 'Unique Burn', inflict 2 Burn Potency on all enemies (or all Abnormality parts).

gifts.name: Phlebotomy Pack
gifts.effect:
When hitting an enemy with a Skill, heal 12.5% of the character’s missing HP. (Once per character per turn.)
If the Skill’s Affinity was Wrath, heal 25% of missing HP instead.

gifts.name: Wound Clerid
gifts.effect: When hitting an enemy with a Skill that inflicts Bleed Potency or 'Unique Bleed', inflict 4 Bleed Potency.

gifts.name: Coffee and Cranes
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: Gain +1 E.G.O resource of a random Affinity that does not correspond to any Attack Skill Affinity used last turn.
If a Lust Affinity Attack Skill was used last turn: Gain 1 of every Affinity E.G.O resource that does not correspond to any Attack Skill Affinity used last turn instead.

gifts.name: Eclipse of Scarlet Moths
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: When dealing damage with an Attack Skill for the first time, deal half its damage as fixed damage to a random enemy.
If the Attack Skill's Affinity was Lust, deal said damage to two random enemies instead.

gifts.name: Grimy Iron Stake
gifts.effect:
When hitting an enemy using a single-Coin skill, inflict 1 Bleed Potency. Inflict 2 Defense Level Down until the end of the next turn.
If the target already has Bleed or 'Unique Bleed', inflict 3 Bleed Potency instead.

gifts.name: Fiery Down
gifts.effect:
When hitting an enemy with a Lust Affinity Skill or a Skill that inflicts Burn Potency or 'Unique Burn', inflict 3 Burn Potency.
Turn Start: If the enemy has 20+ Burn Potency, (Current Burn Potency on enemy) x2

gifts.name: Bloody Gadget
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: apply 2 Damage Up to a random ally.
Prioritizes allies with Lust Affinity Attack skills; apply 1 additional Damage Up to the said ally.

gifts.name: Sunshower
gifts.effect:
When activating Sloth Absolute Resonance or using a Skill with 2+ Atk Weight:
All allies gain +2 Skill Power at Combat Start.

gifts.name: Today’s Expression
gifts.effect: If an enemy is killed by Attack End of a Blunt Skill or a Sloth Skill: For 2 turns, starting next turn, raise the Blunt Skill Power by 2 for the unit who used the Skill

gifts.name: Talisman Bundle
gifts.effect:
Whenever an ally deals 12+ HP damage to an enemy with a Skill, inflict 2 Rupture Potency on target.
When using a Slash Skill, inflict 4 Rupture Potency instead.

gifts.name: Rusty Commemorative Coin
gifts.effect:
If the first single-Coin Attack Skill that an ally uses during the combat phase doesn’t defeat any enemies, use the Skill one more time.
After defeating an enemy by using a Sloth or single-Coin Skill, the ally gains +1 Skill Power for the next turn.

gifts.name: Blood, Sweat, and Tears
gifts.effect:
Skills deal +10% damage to Staggered enemies.
If the Skill inflicts Tremor Potency, Tremor Count, triggers Amplitude Conversion, Tremor Burst, or Amplitude Entanglement, or if the Skill's Affinity was Sloth, deal +20% damage instead.

gifts.name: Green Spirit
gifts.effect: After hitting a non-Staggered enemy by using a Gluttony Affinity Skill, or inflicting Tremor Potency using Skill effects, randomly inflict a total of 4 Tremor Potency between all enemies(or all Abnormality parts).

gifts.name: Lithograph
gifts.effect:
Whenever an enemy is Staggered, the ally with the least HP heals 5% of their Max HP.
If said ally has Gluttony Affinity Attack Skills, heal 10% of Max HP instead.

gifts.name: Crown of Roses
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: inflict 4 Rupture Potency on a random enemy(or all Abnormality parts).
When activating Gluttony Absolute Resonance, inflict 2 Rupture Potency on all enemies at Combat Start.

gifts.name: Sticky Muck
gifts.effect: When hitting an enemy with a Pierce Skill or a Gluttony Affinity Skill, inflict 2 Defense Level Down.

gifts.name: White Gossypium
gifts.effect: Turn Start: If there are Staggered enemies, un-Stagger enemies. Then, inflict (8 + Stagger LV x 4) Bleed Potency and (8 + Stagger LV x4)/2 Offense Level Down on them this turn and next turn. (Activates once per enemy per Encounter. Does not activate against certain enemies that do not recover from Stagger)

gifts.name: Blue Zippo Lighter
gifts.effect: Turn Start: gain +1 Gloom E.G.O resource and +1 E.G.O resource of 2 other random Affinities.

gifts.name: Phantom Pain
gifts.effect:
Skills with 1 Atk Weight deal +15% damage.
When activating Gloom Absolute Resonance, apply 2 Offense Level Up to all allies at Combat Start.

gifts.name: Thunderbranch
gifts.effect: When inflicting Rupture Potency with Skill effects, Inflict 1 Rupture Potency and +1 Rupture Count on target.

gifts.name: Melted Eyeball
gifts.effect: Inflict 5 Offense Level Down and 5 Defense Level Down next turn against enemies affected by Tremor Burst. (3 times per turn)

gifts.name: Grey Coat
gifts.effect:
When using a Skill with 2+ Atk Weight, increase its damage by 20%.
When hitting an enemy with a Skill with 2+ Atk Weight or a Gloom Affinity Skill, heal by 20% of the damage dealt.

gifts.name: Late-bloomer’s Tattoo
gifts.effect: When hitting an enemy with a single-Coin Skill or a Pride Affinity Skill, gain 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Up next turn. (Max 5)

gifts.name: Lowest Star
gifts.effect:
When hitting an enemy with a Blunt Skill or a Pride Affinity Skill, inflict 2 fixed SP damage on target.
Allies with less than 0 SP deal +10% damage.

gifts.name: Prejudice
gifts.effect:
First Turn Start of an Encounter: the ally with the least HP heals 15% of their Max HP.
When activating Pride Absolute Resonance, the ally with the least HP heals 12.5% of their missing HP at Combat Start.

gifts.name: Little and To-be-Naughty Plushie
gifts.effect:
Deal +10% damage against enemies with Bleed at Combat Start
Take -20% damage from enemies with Bleed or 'Unique Bleed' at Combat Start
Allies with Pride Affinity Attack Skills deal +20% damage against enemies with Bleed or 'Unique Bleed' instead.
Allies with Pride Affinity Attack Skills take -30% damage from enemies with Bleed or 'Unique Bleed' instead.

gifts.name: Gathering Skulls
gifts.effect: If an enemy is killed by Attack End of a Pierce Skill or a Pride Skill: For 2 turns, starting next turn, raise the Pierce Skill Power by 2 for the unit who used the Skill

gifts.name: Nixie Divergence
gifts.effect:
First Turn Start of an Encounter: inflict 4 Tremor Potency and 4 Tremor Count to all enemies. (Or all Abnormality parts)
When hitting an enemy with an Envy Affinity Skill, inflict 2 Tremor Potency on target.

gifts.name: Dreaming Electric Sheep
gifts.effect:
If an enemy is killed by Attack End of a Slash Skill or an Envy Skill: For 2 turns, starting next turn, raise the Slash Skill Power by 2 for the unit who used the Skill
When activating Envy A-Reson., all allies gain 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Up at Combat Start

gifts.name: Standard-duty Battery
gifts.effect:
When hitting an enemy with a Skill, inflict 3 Rupture Potency on target.
If the Skill's Affinity was Envy, inflict 5 Rupture Potency on target instead.

gifts.name: Pinpoint Logic Circuit
gifts.effect:
When hitting an enemy with an Envy Affinity Skill or a Skill that inflicts Burn Potency or 'Unique Burn', inflict additional Burn Potency by half the Skill's total Coins. (rounded up)
- [Cannot Stack] When Move-in Reg. Heathcliff E.G.O Passive 「Circuit Wiring」 activates, this effect does not activate 
 On Hit, if the target has 99 Burn Potency, inflict 1 Resident Reg. Microchip (once per enemy, 3 times per turn)

gifts.name: Voodoo Doll
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: deal 3 fixed Envy Affinity damage to all enemies.
Inflict 1 Power Down to enemies with 33% or less HP.

gifts.name: Carmilla
gifts.effect: At the start of a non-Focused Encounter, all enemies take fixed damage equal to 20% of their Max HP.

gifts.name: Child within a Flask
gifts.effect:
Encounter Start: Gain +1 E.G.O resource for every Sin Affinity
Upon winning an Encounter, gain 2 E.G.O resource for the 2 least owned Affinities

gifts.name: Illusory Hunt
gifts.effect: Focused Encounter Start: Apply 2 Damage Up to all allies.

gifts.name: Homeward
gifts.effect: Encounter Start: all participating allies heal 12% of their Max HP.

gifts.name: Tomorrow’s Fortune
gifts.effect: Upgrade the first Encounter Reward Card to the highest tier it could spawn as.

gifts.name: Red Order
gifts.effect:
Whenever an ally inflicts Sinking Potency, Count or 'Unique Sinking' on enemies with Skill Effects, the ally gains 1 'Offense Level' next turn. (Max 3)
Allies with Gloom or Wrath Affinity Attack Skills, upon inflicting Sinking Potency or Count on enemies with Skill Effects, gain 2 'Offense Level' next turn instead. (Max 4)

gifts.name: Smokes and Wires
gifts.effect:
Against enemies, allies inflict x2 Bleed Potency with Skill effects.
Turn End: enemies with Bleed or 'Unique Bleed' lose 2 Speed next turn.

gifts.name: Employee Card
gifts.effect: When activating Wrath Absolute Resonance or using a Skill that gains or applies Charge Count or 'Unique Charge', all allies gain +3 Charge Count at the next Turn Start. (Once per turn)

gifts.name: Oscillating Bracelet
gifts.effect:
When hitting an enemy with a Skill, inflict 1 Tremor Potency next turn.
If the Skill's Affinity was Wrath, inflict 2 Tremor Potency instead.

gifts.name: Glimpse of Flames
gifts.effect:
Turn End: consume half of Burn Count on enemies with Burn to deal (Burn Potency x consumed Burn Count) bonus Wrath damage. (can consume up to 5 Burn Count)
Targets lose (Burn Count consumed by Glimpse of Flames) Defense Levels for the next turn. (max 3)

gifts.name: Cigarette Holder
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: allies with Poise gain 1 Power Up.
Allies with 5+ Poise Count gain 2 Power Up instead.

gifts.name: Barbed Lasso
gifts.effect:
Turn End: Inflict Rupture Potency on all enemies equal to their current Speed values.
When activating Lust Absolute Resonance, apply 3 Rupture Potency and +3 Rupture Count to a random enemy at Combat Start.

gifts.name: Rusted Cutting Knife
gifts.effect:
When inflicting Bleed Potency or 'Unique Bleed' with Skill effects against non-Staggered enemies, inflict 1 Bleed Potency and +1 Bleed Count.
If the Skill's Affinity was Lust, inflict 3 Bleed Potency and +1 Bleed Count instead.

gifts.name: Thorny Path
gifts.effect:
When hitting and dealing HP damage to an enemy with a Skill that inflicts Sinking Potency or 'Unique Sinking', inflict 3 Sinking Potency and +2 Sinking Count at Turn End. (Once per enemy per turn)
When activating Gloom or Lust Absolute Resonance, inflict 2 Sinking Potency and +3 Sinking Count to all enemies(for Abnormalities, a random Part) at Combat Start.

gifts.name: Red-stained Gossypium
gifts.effect:
First Turn Start of an Encounter: inflict 1 Bleed Potency and +15 Bleed Count to all enemies (or all Abnormality parts).
Turn Start: enemies with Bleed Potency lose (Bleed Potency/3) 'Offense Level' and 'Defense Level' for the turn. (Maxes out at 30 Bleed Potency stack)

gifts.name: Stone Tomb
gifts.effect:
Allies gain 1.5x Poise Potency from Skill effects.
When an ally defeats an enemy with a Sloth Affinity Skill, they gain 2 Poise Potency and +2 Poise Count at the next Turn Start. (Once per turn)

gifts.name: Portable Battery Socket
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: Two random allies gain +2 Charge Count. (Prioritizes Identities with Skills that gain Charge Count or 'Unique Charge')
When activating Sloth Absolute Resonance, one random ally gains +3 Charge Count at Combat Start.

gifts.name: Dust to Dust
gifts.effect:
First Turn Start of a wave: inflict 5 Burn Potency and +3 Burn Count to all enemies. (for Abnormalities, one random Part)
When activating Sloth Absolute Resonance, inflict 3 Burn Potency and +2 Burn Count to all enemies (for Abnormalities, one random Part) at Combat Start.

gifts.name: Melted Spring
gifts.effect: Turn Start: enemies with Sinking lose 3 'Offense Level' and 'Defense Level' for the turn.

gifts.name: Downpour
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: Inflict (Current Turn Count x 2) Tremor Potency and +2 Tremor Count on all enemies (or all Abnormality parts).
Turn End: Trigger Tremor Burst on all enemies (or all Abnormality parts).

gifts.name: Four-leaf Clover
gifts.effect:
When an ally with Poise at Combat Start Critical Hits an enemy, gain 5 Poise Potency and +2 Poise Count at the next Turn Start. (Once per turn)
If the Skill's Affinity was Gluttony, gain 7 Poise Potency and +3 Poise Count instead at the next Turn Start.

gifts.name: Nightvision Goggles
gifts.effect:
This Gift activates when an ally has 15+ Charge Count at Turn Start. (including 'Unique Charge')
Combat Start: the ally with 15+ Charge Count loses 3 Charge Count and gains 5 'Offense Level' for the turn.

gifts.name: Disk Fragment
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: gain +1 E.G.O resource of a random Affinity for each non-Gluttony E.G.O skill used last turn.
If a Gluttony Affinity E.G.O Skill was used, gain +3 E.G.O resources of a random Affinity for each Gluttony E.G.O Skill used last turn instead.

gifts.name: Midwinter Nightmare
gifts.effect:
When hitting and dealing HP damage to an enemy with a Skill, inflict 3 Sinking Potency.
If the Skill's Affinity was Gluttony, inflict 5 Sinking Potency instead.

gifts.name: Thrill
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: inflict 3 Rupture Potency and +3 Rupture Count on all enemies. (or all Abnormality Parts)
Turn End: Inflict (Rupture Potency x Rupture Count) Gluttony damage to all enemies. (for Abnormalities, all Parts) (counts up to 5 Rupture Count)

gifts.name: Skeletal Crumbs
gifts.effect:
Deal +12.5% damage and take -12.5% damage against enemies that had Sinking at Combat Start.
Allies with Gloom Affinity Attack Skills deal +20% damage and take -20% damage instead.

gifts.name: Curriculum Vitae
gifts.effect:
Turn End: allies with 7+ (Charge Count + 'Unique Charge') gain 1 Haste next turn.
If the ally has Gloom Affinity Skills, gain 2 Haste and 1 Power Up next turn instead.

gifts.name: Pendant of Nostalgia
gifts.effect:
Combat Start: a random ally gains 3 Poise Potency. (Prioritizes Identities with Attack Skills that gain Poise Counts)
Prioritizes allies with Gloom Affinity Attack Skills; those allies gain 3 Poise Potency and +2 Poise Count.

gifts.name: Broken Revolver
gifts.effect: Turn Start: enemies(or Abnormality parts) with Rupture have their 'Offense Level' and 'Defense Level' reduced by 2 for the turn.

gifts.name: Artistic Sense
gifts.effect:
Deal +35% damage against enemies suffering negative effects (Low Morale, Panic) from SP loss.
If the Skill inflicts Sinking Potency or Count(including 'Unique Sinking'), deal +10% damage in addition to the above.
When Sinking's effect applies to enemies that are Non-SP Units, the Affinity of the damage inflicted changes to whatever is the most effective.

gifts.name: Nebulizer
gifts.effect:
First Turn Start of an Encounter: all allies gain 4 Poise Potency and +4 Poise Count.
When activating Pride Absolute Resonance, all allies gain 2 Poise Potency and +2 Poise Count at Combat Start. 
 - [Cannot Stack] When Thoracalgia Ryōshū E.G.O Passive 「Breath」 activates, this effect does not activate

gifts.name: Special Contract
gifts.effect: Enemies Staggered by taking Skill damage also receive fixed damage by 33% of their Max HP (for Abnormalities, the Part's HP), and are inflicted with 2 Fragile next turn. (Once per Encounter)

gifts.name: Grand Welcome
gifts.effect:
Encounter Start: gain +5 Pride E.G.O resources.
Whenever an enemy dies, gain +2 Pride E.G.O resources and +1 E.G.O resource for 2 other random Affinities.

gifts.name: Wrist Guards
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: allies with 5+ (Charge Count + 'Unique Charge') gain 1 Damage Up.
If the ally has Pride Affinity Attack Skills, gain 2 Damage Up instead.

gifts.name: Clear Mirror, Calm Water
gifts.effect:
Increase the allies' Critical Hit damage multiplier from x1.2 to x1.7.
If a Critical Hit consumed Poise Count, the ally gains 10 Offense Level Up next turn. (activates once per Identity, per turn)

gifts.name: Charred Disk
gifts.effect:
When an enemy with Burn is defeated (for Abnormalities, when the Core is defeated), inflict half of the Burn Potency on the defeated enemy to an enemy with the least Burn Potency at the next Turn Start.
Turn Start: inflict 4 Offense Level Down to enemies with Burn for the turn.

gifts.name: Lightning Rod
gifts.effect:
Encounter Start: all allies gain +3 Charge Count.
If two or more participating allies have Envy Affinity Attack Skills, all allies gain +5 Charge Count instead.

gifts.name: Endorphin Kit
gifts.effect:
When gaining Poise Potency from Skill effects, gain 1 Poise Potency and +1 Poise Count.
If the Skill's Affinity was Envy, the ally gains 2 Poise Potency and +2 Poise Count instead.

gifts.name: Headless Portrait
gifts.effect:
Combat Start: Inflict 2 Sinking Potency on all enemies with less than 0 SP. (for Abnormalities, one random part)
For each Envy Affinity Skill used, randomly inflict 1 Sinking Potency between all enemies next turn. (for Abnormalities, one random part)

gifts.name: Charge-type Gloves
gifts.effect:
Max Charge Count +10.
Encounter Start: All allies gain +5 Charge Count.
Turn Start: All allies gain +2 Charge Count.
[#1 Deployed Identity Exclusive Effect] Encounter Start: gain 1 Near-light Superbattery

gifts.name: First-aid Kit
gifts.effect: Turn Start: one ally under 50% HP heals 25% of Max HP. (Once per Encounter; does not activate if the ally is dead)

gifts.name: Painkiller
gifts.effect: Turn Start: Staggered allies heal by 12.5% of Max HP and gain 3 Protection for this turn.

gifts.name: Voracious Hammer
gifts.effect: After winning a combat Encounter, gain 3 Cost for each enemy defeated.

gifts.name: Golden Urn
gifts.effect: Gain +20% Cost after winning a combat Encounter. (Not affected by Starter Buffs or other E.G.O Gifts)

gifts.name: Milepost of Survival
gifts.effect: Upon clearing Floor Boss: gain (80 + # of Identities participating in the Encounter x 5) additional Cost (unaffected by effects that raise Cost after clearing an Encounter)

gifts.name: Faith
gifts.effect: After using a Plus Coin Skill, fully heal the ally's SP at the next Turn Start. (Unless corroded).

gifts.name: Piece of Relationship
gifts.effect: Upon Acquisition: All Deployed Identities gain 5 Levels.

gifts.name: Lunar Memory
gifts.effect: All type and Affinity resistances of enemies (for Abnormalities, all Parts) change to 'Fatal'.

gifts.name: Ancient Effigy
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: select one of the fastest allies and apply 5 Haste to them next turn.
Next Turn Start: select one of the other fastest allies (allies without the Ancient Effigy effect) and re-apply the Gift effect to them. (effect expires if no other allies can be selected)
At 10+ Speed, the ally gains (Speed difference with the target / 2) Offense Level (max 5; rounded down)

gifts.name: Non-disclosure Agreement
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: A random ally deals +10% damage and gains Shield equal to 49% of max HP (effective until Non-disclosure Agreement effect expires).
The ally deals additional +10% damage every time it hits with a Skill and deals HP damage to an enemy (max +40% damage)
If the ally takes HP damage, the Gift's effect expires. At the next Turn Start, apply the same Gift effect to another random ally. (accumulated damage boost carries over; effect expires if no other allies can be selected)

gifts.name: Reverberation
gifts.effect:
Turn End: Inflict 2 Bind to enemies (for Abnormalities, their Parts) with 10+ Tremor Potency.
If the target has 20+ Tremor Potency, apply 2 Bind and 1 Paralyze instead.

gifts.name: Burning Intellect
gifts.effect: After defeating an enemy with a Burn effect, 2 allies with Skills that inflict Burn Potency gains 1 Damage Up at the next Turn Start.

gifts.name: Soothe the Dead
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply Burn Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn' (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)
Turn Start: Inflict +6 Burn Count to all enemies and randomly inflict a total of 15 Burn Potency between all enemies (or all Abnormality parts; once per wave)
Plus Coin Skills that inflict Burn Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn': Final Power +1, Coin Power +1, inflicted Burn Potency +1, inflicted Burn Count +1
 - Minus Coin Base Attack Skills: Instead of gaining Coin Power, gain Base Power +(4 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down)
When winning a Clash with a Skill that inflicts Burn Potency, Count, or 'Unique Burn', inflict (# of remaining Coins + 1) Burn Potency to the target enemy.

gifts.name: Rusted Muzzle
gifts.effect:
When hitting and dealing 12+ HP damage to an enemy with a Skill, inflict 2 Bleed Potency.
When using a Slash Skill, inflict 4 Bleed Potency instead.

gifts.name: Bloody Mist
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply Bleed Potency, Count, or 'Unique Bleed'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)
Allies inflict double the amount of Bleed Potency and Count with Skill effects against enemies.
The ally highest in the Deployment order: Plus Coin Skills that inflict Bleed Potency, Count, or 'Unique Bleed': Coin Power +2 and deal +100% damage. 
 - Minus Coin Skills: Instead of gaining Coin Power, gain Base Power +(8 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down) 
 If the enemy attacked by or Clashed with the said ally dies, inflict the remaining Bleed Potency on the enemy randomly between all enemies. (for Focused Encounters, Parts)
Plus Coin Skills that inflict Bleed Potency, Count, or 'Unique Bleed': Coin Power +1, deal +30% damage 
 - Minus Coin Skills: Instead of gaining Coin Power, gain Base Power +(4 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down)

gifts.name: Bell of Truth
gifts.effect: Inflict 1 Fragile this turn to enemies affected by Tremor Burst. (Activates once per Attack Skill that triggers Tremor Burst)

gifts.name: Coupled Oscillation
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply Tremor Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)
Inflict 5 Tremor and +5 Tremor Count to all enemies. (or all Abnormality parts; once per wave)
Apply 5 Tremor Potency and 2 Fragile this turn and next turn to enemies affected by Tremor Burst. (activates once per Attack Skill that triggers Tremor Burst)
After triggering 3 Tremor Burst to a target this turn, Stagger the target at the next Turn Start and add a new Stagger Threshold at 66% and 33% marks of the target's current HP. (once per Encounter)
When triggering Amplitude Conversion or Amplitude Entanglement, inflict 1 Fragile (3 times per turn)

gifts.name: Fluorescent Lamp
gifts.effect: Turn End: If there are enemies or Abnormality parts with Rupture, apply 1 Damage Up or 1 Haste to a random ally next turn. Repeat (# of enemies(or # of Abnormality Parts) with Rupture + 1) times.

gifts.name: Enrapturing Trance
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply Rupture Potency or Count. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)
When hitting an enemy with a Skill, inflict 5 Rupture Potency.
- Skills that inflict Rupture Potency or Count: Inflict an additional 3 Rupture Potency and +1 Rupture Count (once per Skill)
When Rupture Count on an enemy drops below 1, consume 10 Rupture Potency instead of Rupture Count. (This effect ends when Rupture Potency drops below 10)
If the target has less than 3 Rupture Count, inflict +1 more Count when inflicting Rupture Count. (3 times per Encounter)

gifts.name: Broken Compass
gifts.effect:
First Turn Start of a wave: randomly inflict (5 + (# of enemies x 3)) Sinking Count between all enemies (or all Abnormality parts).
(For Abnormalities, only the Core counts as an enemy)

gifts.name: Black Sheet Music
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply Sinking Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)
On Hit against an enemy with a Skill: inflict 5 Sinking Potency.
Turn Start: enemies or Parts with Sinking regain (Sinking Count each enemy lost On Hit last turn / 2) Sinking Count.
On Hit with a Base Attack Skill: deal (Sinking Potency on target / 10) Gloom damage (min 1 damage)
On Hit with an Attack Skill: if the target's SP is below 0, Skill deals more damage the further the target's SP is from 0 (+1% damage per SP)
- If target is Panicked, deal +50% damage instead
- For targets that are Non-SP Units: Deal +1% damage for every 2 Sinking Potency on target. If target has 90+ Sinking Potency, deal +50% damage instead

gifts.name: Ornamental Horseshoe
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: apply 2 Poise Potency to 2 random allies without Poise.
When all allies have Poise Potency, apply 1 Poise Count to all allies instead.

gifts.name: Lucky Pouch
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply or gain Poise Potency or Count. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)
Combat Start: If a random ally with Poise Critical Hits on an enemy with a Skill, all allies gain 7 Poise Potency and +7 Poise Count at the next Turn Start. (Once per turn)
Skill 3 of Identities with Skills that apply or gain Poise Potency or Count(not counting E.G.O Skills): Final Power +3, Plus Coin Power +(12 / # of Coins), damage dealt +(50 / # of Coins)%.
- Minus Coin Skills: Instead of gaining Plus Coin Power, gain Final Power +(12 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down)
Combat Start: a random ally gains 3 Poise Potency. (prioritizes Identities that apply or gain Poise Potency or Count with their Attack Skills) Prioritizes allies with Gloom Affinity Attack Skills; they gain 3 Poise Potency and +2 Poise Count.

gifts.name: Material Interference Force Field
gifts.effect: First Turn Start of a wave: all allies gain 3 Charge Barrier.

gifts.name: T-1 Perpetual Motion Machine
gifts.effect:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that gain Charge Count or 'Unique Charge'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)
Turn Start: all allies gain 7 Charge Barrier (once per wave).
Turn Start: all allies gain ((Charge Count)/5 +1) Damage Up. (max 9, rounded up; including 'Unique Charge')
Each Identity gains (total Charge Count consumed by using Attack Skills during this Encounter / 4) Offense Level Up at Turn Start. (maxes out after consuming 40 Charge Count)
Each Identity gains 1 Charge every time they consume 10 Charge Count. (5 times per Identity per Encounter; does not interact with 'Unique Charge' with fixed Potency)
Turn Start: all allies gain 1 Attack Power Up for every 2 Charge Potency on their respective selves (max 3)
